description: Create or update a native auto-repost rule on Studio or Pro for a connected Bluesky, Mastodon or X account. Automatically boosts new posts once after your chosen delay (1 to 168 hours), watermarked at creation so back catalogs are never blasted, with daily/gap/monthly caps, optional minLikes filter and skip tags (default #norepost). X rules boost Spica-published posts only ($0 X read cost) and obey the monthly X post ceiling. Show the customer the account and settings before enabling.

accountId.description: The connected Bluesky, Mastodon or X account id from accounts_list to auto-repost.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

delayHours.description: Hours to wait after a post goes out before natively reposting it once (1 to 168; default 24).

id.description: An auto-repost rule id from autoreposts_list to update. Leave out to create a new rule.

includeNative.description: On Bluesky or Mastodon, also boost native posts published outside Spica Post (default true on Bluesky and Mastodon; always false on X to keep X read cost at zero).

maxPerDay.description: Maximum auto-reposts per 24 hours on this account (1 to 10; default 3).

minGapHours.description: Minimum hours between consecutive auto-reposts on this account (1 to 24; default 2).

minLikes.description: Optional minimum likes required before boosting a post (0 boosts all eligible posts; default 0).

on.description: Set true to boost eligible posts automatically (default true), or false to pause the rule.

skipTags.description: Up to 10 tags that prevent a post from being auto-reposted (defaults to ["#norepost"]). Case-insensitive.

name: autoreposts_save
title: Save an auto-repost rule
